(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, and wherein the body is formed from a heat-dissipating material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are arranged non-uniformly in a pattern around the columnar body.

(Previously presented) Claim 10: The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are each aligned with the diodes.

(Previously presented) Claim 3: The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes.

(Previously presented) Claim 4: The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material.

(Previously presented) Claim 12: The lamp of claim 1 including a single optic element that is disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode.

(Previously presented) Claim 14: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current and providing pulse width modulation control.

(Previously presented) Claim 15: The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light in a programmable pattern.
